notes.south-houses: One entry for four adjoining houses (Blacker, Dabney, Fleming, Ricketts); pin is OSM's Fleming House (relation/10129302), the house nearest the middle of the four (the mean of their centroids falls in the Student Activities Center).
notes.north-houses: One entry for the North Houses; pin is the mean of OSM's Lloyd House, Page House and Venerable House centroids (ways 32735342, 32735362, 32735305); OSM has no separately named Ruddock House. The point falls inside Lloyd House.
notes.catalina-complex: OSM leaves the Catalina apartment buildings unnamed; pin is the mean of its named Central, North and South Catalina common rooms (ways 857648974, 1053224839, 1053224840), the middle of the complex.
notes.TCT: TCT (Theater Arts at Caltech) only word-matched OSM's "Center for the Arts"; not confirmed to be the same building, so TCT isn't placed.

detours.why: Bechtel Residence (relation/9162392) has no mapped entrance; its centre snaps to the footway on its south side, so the walk north to IMSS goes round the building.
